candidate_source.decoder_api: private test-only sample::wire::decode_sample(&[u8]); public Sample::from_bytes reads the binary container
candidate_source.encoding_api: private test-only sample::wire::encode_sample(&Sample, explicit_level); production Sample::to_bytes uses fixed trial level 3

capture_harness.capture_execution: host-native PTY; one scenario at a time; same downstream reference binaries and deterministic environment

commands.candidate_test: TUISCOTTI_BENCH_INPUT=<new-capture-samples> TUISCOTTI_BENCH_OUTPUT=<run-output> TUISCOTTI_BENCH_LEVELS=<level> mbx nextest run --locked --offline -p tuiscotti --lib -E test(export_local_captures_at_explicit_zstd_levels) --no-capture
commands.candidate_timed_invocation: Use the frozen optimized release candidate test binary directly under /usr/bin/time -l with the exact test name, --exact --nocapture; this reports encoder/decoder process RSS and avoids Cargo/Nextest orchestration in the timed region.
commands.history_variant_export: tools/export-history-variants.py; verification-only test branch builds valid encoded files and checks logical digest round trips at each configured Zstd level, without recording timing.

created_by: isolated benchmark preparation; 10 native paired PTY capture scenarios; no downstream baseline files used as codec inputs

git_history_workload.status: seven changed-file stages encoded and roundtrip verified on prior trial; current raw protobuf corpus is byte-identical; deletion is an empty-file operation; provisional storage results
git_history_workload.storage_measurement_status: completed; size data only, no timing reported

limitations: Only macos-aarch64 platform contract is captured natively; Linux x86_64 reference binaries exist, but emulated Docker is not native evidence.
The candidate Protobuf codec is private and is not wired into public Sample or CLI storage; this measures codec operations, not production accept/check/render-read behavior.
End-to-end capture/check/accept/render-read CPU, wall time, and RSS are not measured; this codec matrix alone cannot establish user-path impact.
Integration source-proof/resource-limit findings remain unresolved in the experimental candidate and block any production decision.
The realistic Git history is built from fresh captures and documented edits; history storage and checkout measurements are separate from this codec matrix.

measurements.candidate_codec: current experimental Protobuf container encoder/decoder; explicit level via private test seam
measurements.contention_policy: Any run performed with --allow-contended is timing-selection-ineligible and includes per-task host observations.
measurements.execution_profile: optimized release test binary; test harness still includes sample reconstruction and correctness checks, not only codec calls.
measurements.interleave: Each of five passes shuffles all 52 fixed tasks with Python Random(seed=20261105+pass_number); the exact task sequence is recorded per pass.
measurements.verify: Every external codec output is decompressed and byte-compared with source; candidate container is decoded and public state_digest compared with source Sample.
